cases.sentence: ___ сказал Иакову: «Поднимись в Вифиль, поселись там и построй там жертвенник Богу».
cases.translation: God said to Jacob: 'Arise, go up to Bethel, live there, and build there an altar to God.'
cases.explain: Бог is the subject performing the action «сказал», so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: ...when you fled from your brother Esau.
cases.explain: The preposition «от» (from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Бог сказал ___, «Поднимись в Вифиль, поселись там...»
cases.translation: God said to Jacob, 'Arise, go up to Bethel, live there...'
cases.explain: The verb «сказать» takes its addressee in the dative case — сказал кому? Иакову.

cases.sentence: «___, которую я дал Аврааму и Исааку, я отдаю тебе».
cases.translation: 'The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I am giving to you.'
cases.explain: The land is the direct object of the verb «отдаю» (I give), which requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Иаков закопал их под ___ в Шехеме.
cases.translation: Jacob buried them under the oak in Shechem.
cases.explain: The preposition «под» (under, indicating location) governs the instrumental case here.

cases.sentence: Иаков поставил каменный столб на том ___, где Бог говорил с ним.
cases.translation: Jacob set up a stone pillar in that place where God had spoken with him.
cases.explain: The preposition «на» (at/on, indicating a fixed location) requires the prepositional case: на том месте.

reading.ru: Бог сказал Иакову, «Поднимись в Вифиль, поселись там и построй там жертвенник Богу, который явился тебе, когда ты бежал от своего брата Исава».
reading.question: What did God tell Jacob to do at Bethel?
options: Build an altar to God who appeared to him when he fled from Esau
reading.correct: Build an altar to God who appeared to him when he fled from Esau
reading.explain: God told Jacob to go up to Bethel and build an altar there to the God who had appeared to him when he fled from his brother Esau.

reading.ru: Иаков закопал их под дубом в Шехеме.
reading.question: What did Jacob do with the foreign gods and earrings his household gave him?
options: He buried them under the oak at Shechem
He threw them into a river
He sold them in the marketplace
He gave them to a priest
reading.correct: He buried them under the oak at Shechem
reading.explain: Jacob buried the foreign gods and earrings under the oak near Shechem before continuing on to Bethel.

reading.ru: Дзевора, кормилица Ревекия, умерла и была похоронена под дубом близ Вифиля, поэтому он был назван «Дуб плача».
reading.question: Who died and was buried under an oak near Bethel, giving the tree its name?
reading.explain: Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died and was buried under the oak near Bethel, which was then called 'the oak of weeping.'

reading.ru: Бог сказал ему, «Я Бог всемогущий, плодись и умножайся. Народ и множество народов произойдут от тебя, и цари произойдут от твоих чресел».
reading.question: What did God promise Jacob (now Israel) after renaming him?
options: That nations and kings would come from him
That he would become a priest
That he would return to Egypt
reading.correct: That nations and kings would come from him
reading.explain: God, identifying himself as God Almighty, promised Jacob that a nation and company of nations, and kings, would come from him.

reading.ru: Когда Рахиль испускала дух, умирая, она назвала сына Бен-Онии, но отец назвал его Вениамин.
reading.question: What happened as Rachel was dying in childbirth?
options: She named her son Ben-Oni, but Jacob renamed him Benjamin
She asked Jacob to bury her in Egypt
She refused to name the child
She named the child after Joseph
reading.correct: She named her son Ben-Oni, but Jacob renamed him Benjamin
reading.explain: As she was dying, Rachel named her newborn son Ben-Oni, but his father Jacob called him Benjamin.

reading.ru: Рувим лег с наложницей отца Валлой, и Израиль узнал об этом.
reading.question: What did Reuben do while Israel lived in that land?
options: He slept with his father's concubine Bilhah
reading.correct: He slept with his father's concubine Bilhah
reading.explain: Reuben lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine, and Israel heard about it.

reading.ru: Исаак испустил дух, умер и отошел к своим предкам, старым и насытившимся жизнью. Его сыновья Исаав и Иаков похоронили его.
reading.question: How did Isaac's life end, and who buried him?
options: He died old and full of days, and was buried by Esau and Jacob
He died young in an accident
He was buried by his servants only
reading.correct: He died old and full of days, and was buried by Esau and Jacob
reading.explain: Isaac died at the age of 180, old and full of days, and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
